name: Sony BRAVIA 4K UR2
summary: Turn off Samba TV, shop and demo apps and recommendation rows on the Sony BRAVIA 4K UR2 with TidyTV, a free phone app with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: The Sony BRAVIA 4K UR2 ships with Samba TV, a viewing tracker that fingerprints what is on screen. It also has recommendation rows, shop and demo apps, a voice assistant group and Chromecast. A set of preloaded apps that most owners skip are on it too.

The list was applied across one afternoon with the dock set to Netflix, YouTube, Disney+ and ZEE5. It has not been used for weeks yet, so check the streaming apps again after a day or two. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, with a backup first and nothing uninstalled. Restore everything switches them back on in one tap.
keep: Live TV and the tuner app, which also plays the HDMI inputs.
The HDMI input and remote services, including Bravia Sync.
Sony's Settings apps and system service, which run the TV's settings and the remote.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my Sony BRAVIA 4K UR2?
faq.a: Not with that group off. The voice group removes the remote's mic search, so leave its three apps on in the app if you use voice.
Yes, if you keep Chromecast built-in on. It is its own group in the list, so its switch can stay on while the rest are turned off.

faq.q: Will it stop the ads on the home screen?
faq.a: It turns off Samba TV, the recommendation rows and the shop and demo apps. Those are the tracking and promo parts of the list.
